speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you notice any burning sensation, urgency, or foul-smelling urine during or after your antibiotic treatment? Also, are you experiencing any nausea or vomiting alongside the fever and flank pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you currently have any itching or a return of the rash, and have you noticed any swelling in your face, hands, or feet? I need to rule out a drug reaction or kidney involvement.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.
